meta.title: Modpack Kit
meta.description: PCL/HMCL-style modpacks for DeepSeek Harness: bundle plugins with their config and data into one .dshpack and install in one pass. Three strategies: full (installs offline), download-only (smallest), hybrid (per-plugin — only what cannot be fetched by version ships inside). Packing scans in memory and redacts suspected credentials (never written to disk; high-risk findings pause until confirmed); installing re-checks sha256, dependencies and licences. Categories, search, paging and groups share the plugin market, and installed plugins register as market versions. The plugin market is recommended, not required.
